description: This file defines the DatatypeDAO interface for data access operations related to custom data types in the OpenMRS project, including methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting ClobDatatypeStorage objects.

classes.name: DatatypeDAO
classes.description: Java interface for data access operations related to custom data types in the OpenMRS system, including methods for getting, saving, and deleting ClobDatatypeStorage objects.

methods.name: getClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Retrieves a ClobDatatypeStorage object by its internal ID.

methods.name: getClobDatatypeStorageByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ClobDatatypeStorage object by its UUID.

methods.name: saveClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Creates or updates a ClobDatatypeStorage object in the database.

methods.name: deleteClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Deletes a ClobDatatypeStorage object from the database.
